about: Versions of the scripted experts per task (scripts/datagen/experts.py). Append only: an improved expert is a new version; registry.json entries name theirs in `expert`.

g1d_sort_blocks_by_color.summary: 第一版：block_sort_actions 经 Limiter 限速，按卡片颜色把积木放进对应托盘

g1d_sort_blocks_by_shape.summary: 第一版：block_sort_actions 经 Limiter 限速，按卡片形状把积木放进对应托盘

g1d_build_block_pattern.summary: 第一版：照卡片摆图案；同一只手连续抓取，空闲的手在后台让开
十种图案带颜色和干扰物，与六个原子积木任务共用积木动作

g1d_pour_beans_half_cup.summary: 第一版：按真机 Eps380 数据倒半杯红豆（PR #78）

g1d_pour_beans_cup_or_mug.summary: 第一版：倒进量杯或马克杯（任一目标），深圳场景

g1d_pour_beans_measuring_cups.summary: 第一版插件：标准 G1-D 采集流水线里的杯对杯倒豆（cup_to_cup_actions）；登记的三份量杯数据都早于插件，没有版本

g1d_place_block_on_mark.summary: 第一版：原子积木动作（_block_atomic）经 Limiter

g1d_stack_block_on_block.summary: 第一版：原子积木动作（_block_atomic）经 Limiter

g1d_pick_named_block.summary: 第一版：原子积木动作（_block_atomic）经 Limiter

g1d_put_block_in_tray.summary: 第一版：原子积木动作（_block_atomic）经 Limiter

g1d_line_up_blocks.summary: 第一版：原子积木动作（_block_atomic）经 Limiter

g1d_rotate_block_parallel.summary: 转积木后夹爪完全张开再松手

g1d_pour_beans_plus.summary: 每杯一套倒豆参数，带特权洒豆反馈和卡住时抖动；验收 plus_v1（杯子放稳 HOLD 帧即停录）
窄口杯池版本（分支 datagen-beans-plus-narrow）
录到脚本结束：两只杯子放下、松手、手退开，再保持 90 帧静止；验收 plus_v2（PR #197）
v3 加刚体豆 32 分区下的雪崩回收：涌出时按涌出量回收最多 4 倍速率、杯口降到最低；插件记录豆子从杯口 / 杯壁 / 杯底离开的计数（不参与验收）。用 32 分区的 g1d_beans_rigid_sim 采
V5e expert: 95% in-B, per-cup grasps, palm-push avoidance, joint-space unwind return, container collider hardening, 3D cup profiles
v5（V5e，plus_v3）在真机运动限值下：每条指令经 scripted_demo.Limiter（0.8 rad/s、离限位 0.05 rad、夹爪 REAL_GRIP_RATE），手臂到位后专家才走下一步（时间拉伸）；只套限速时源杯在会合处撞上还没到位的目标杯。g1d/1320 前 16 个布局探针见 HANDOFF

g1d_pour_beans_half_cup_rigid.summary: 第一版：刚体豆变体，专家同半杯倒豆；还没有采过数据

g1d_pick_anything.summary: 第一版：顶抓目标窄边，按位置的抓取偏航（布局转好），每个关键点等限速后的手臂到位，抬 13 cm
v2：抓取点在顶下 1.2 cm（3 cm 时指根把高物体压倒），下降 75 个动作（30 个时关节限速把路径甩偏 4 cm），目标避开中线 4 cm、y ≥ -0.47
v3：动作同 v2；scripted_demo 的多后端兼容改动（pose_wxyz、link_jacobians，Isaac Sim 5.1 上结果不变）和 pick_anything.py 布局参数化（第 3 轮 L2 布局用，第 1、2 轮布局逐字节不变）进了它的源码

v4：第一次尝试与 v3 的顶抓动作完全相同；失败（合空、抬起后没升 3 cm、手离目标 > 2.5 cm）后按离线 URDF 可达性换候选（翻腕 / 换夹持边 / 换俯角 / 细长物体深握 / 靠中线换手）重抓，最多 3 次，保持段掉落再抓一次；STEP_LIM 1200。同布局 A/B（五维 L2 546 对，de17df1）：合格 73% → 81%，抓空 26% → 17%（降 34%），区域、形状、左右手无退步（GraspRobot，docs/pick-expert-v4.md）

g1d_open_anything.summary: v1: handle taken from the front (fingers 25 deg down, tips clear of the face), hand follows the part's own arc or slide 4 steps ahead of the joint to 1.3 x goal and holds; gives up on a miss over 4 cm or an empty grip
v2: acceptance needs the hand at the handle before the part opens (the task's soft-close springs keep drop-down doors shut); expert motion as v1

v3 (open anything round 1): screen15's approach (Jacobian IK step with null-space posture pull, at most 3 cm / 0.2 rad per step, two finger pitches), stands still when out of reach, re-aims at the part's current handle after sliding in and backs off over 4 cm; acceptance open_anything_v3 (v2 + no frame-to-frame joint jump over 10 deg / 15 mm). Round 1's collection open-anything-r1 ran ebdc822, whose open_anything_actions, plugin and pool module are the same

g1d_place_anything.summary: v1: g1d_pick_anything v3's grasp; X carried at <= 0.15 m/s over the receptacle spot nearest where it lay, waits for X to stop swinging, gives up on a 4 cm slip, set on a support's face or let go with the fingertips 1 cm above a container's top
v2: actions as v1; place_anything.py gains the screening (receptacles screened out of training) and crowded layouts take another receptacle
v3: v2 holding 60 actions (was 30) once the hand is back up: 4 of 12 pilot episodes failed on replay with X still rocking in the acceptance's last 30 frames
v4：放置同 v3，抓取换成 Pick 专家 v4.1（scripts/g1d/grasp_v41.py GraspRobot41：第一次尝试与 v3 动作相同、手偏离目标也照常合爪；合空或抬起后没升 3 cm 才按离线 URDF 可达性换候选重抓，最多 3 次）；STEP_LIM 1400。同布局 A/B（179 对）：抓空 28% → 18%（降 35%），合格 48% → 49%，无退步

放置专家 v4.3：第一次抓取前在 URDF 上回放仿真的 IK（抓取 Arm.ik、放置段 ik_within、Limiter 截断与限速），选整条路线（悬停、抓取、抬起、搬到落点上方、下放）到得了抓取点和下放点的抓法，先 v3，都不行回退 v3；放置段 scripts/g1d/place_v42.py：IK 按 Limiter 截断线停关节、按 X 在手中实际位置下放、掉出手重抓；STEP_LIM 1400。同布局 A/B（179 对，基线 v4.1）：合格 49% → 59%（+21 / −4），分组无退步

g1d_put_anything_in.summary: v1: g1d_pick_anything v3's grasp; X carried at <= 0.15 m/s over the receptacle spot nearest where it lay, waits for X to stop swinging, gives up on a 4 cm slip, set on a support's face or let go with the fingertips 1 cm above a container's top
v2: actions as v1; place_anything.py gains the screening (receptacles screened out of training) and crowded layouts take another receptacle
v3: v2 holding 60 actions (was 30) once the hand is back up: 4 of 12 pilot episodes failed on replay with X still rocking in the acceptance's last 30 frames

v4：放进同 v3，抓取换成 Pick 专家 v4.1（scripts/g1d/grasp_v41.py GraspRobot41：第一次尝试与 v3 动作相同、手偏离目标也照常合爪；合空或抬起后没升 3 cm 才按离线 URDF 可达性换候选重抓，最多 3 次）；STEP_LIM 1400。同布局 A/B（177 对）：抓空 25% → 18%（降 27%，未到 1/3，用户 11-19 接受），合格 44% → 46%，无退步
放置专家 v4.3：同 g1d_place_anything v5，高细物体第一次先握中部（deep）再 v3；同布局 A/B（177 对，基线 v4.1）：合格 46% → 58%（+28 / −8），分组无退步

g1d_handover_anything.summary: v1: giver's off-centre top grasp, carry turning the wrist at most 30 deg/s to the handover in front of the chest, taker's top grasp on the other end (held by both pads before the giver lets go), X leveled about the jaw's closing axis over the support, set down as g1d_place_anything does; acceptance handover_anything_v1
v2: v1 with handover_anything.held taking one pressing pad (v1: both), for the taker's hold check before the giver lets go too; acceptance handover_anything_v2
v2's handover; the taker's place stage as place v4.3 (ik_within moves, set down by where X sits in the hand, given up only when X fell out); A/B against v2 pending

g1d_sort_anything.summary: 第一版：逐件做放置专家 v4.3（scripts/g1d/sort_v43.py）：先放离机器人最远的 Y、Y 那一侧的手搬、落点取槽位近侧；每件第一次抓取前在 URDF 上回放整条路线（抓取、抬起、搬到自己槽位落点上方、下放）选抓法，去容器的高细 X 先握中部，去支撑物先 v3；搬运和下放用 place_v42（IK 按 Limiter 截断线停关节、按 X 实际位置下放、掉出手重抓一次）；STEP_LIM 3800；判据 sort_anything_v1。同布局三组 A/B（11-20，v3+重抓 / v4.1 / v4.3）：r1 170 对 21% / 25% / 39%，r2 167 对 21% / 26% / 45%，按场景、件数、分拣种类分组均不退步
